method: Eyes and chin are hand-marked on the frozen 240px Before portrait. Head region vertices use the 512px source front. The alpha-weighted region includes the main hair, headwear and attached ornaments up to the neck boundary. Hanging hair below the jaw, garments, handheld props and wings are excluded. Polygon edges are review estimates.
